research_scope: Read-only research of two first-party Singapore menu sources absent from existing menu snapshots: COLLIN’S current Northpoint City selected-outlet ordering menu and ICHIKOKUDO official dine-in menu carousel. No delivery platforms, paid APIs, Mapbox, or workbook edits. Menu items/sections/prices are retained only where explicitly visible. The result is bounded and does not claim exhaustive catalog coverage.
